scope: Read-only arithmetic over retained first-window reports. No new benchmark, game, instrumentation, source mutation or gate reclassification.

method.positionKey: All sample metadata except elapsedMs; known-prefix requests join the recorded known_prefix_guard sequence.
method.workComparison: Per-round exact comparison of sample metadata, request metadata excluding durations, and every observation.

findings: All recorded work samples, request metadata and observations match exactly. This excludes an observable work-count or action-position mix change, but does not count internal admission probes or bytes hashed/cloned.

STCK pooled restoration median rises 23.03% despite identical 18-with-plan/18-without-plan populations: without-plan median +9.78%, with-plan median -17.36%. The global midpoint moves because the largest short restoration changes from 5.286ms to 10.500ms, paired with the smallest long restoration 13.867ms then 13.064ms.
STCK new-decision per-position medians have two increases above 10% (positions0,9); four other positions range from -6.73% to +6.52%. SMLP has four increases above10% (positions3,4,7,9).

SMLP new-decision positions7 and9 have disjoint observed three-sample ranges with every after sample slower. A real localized cost increase remains plausible; not all excess may be dismissed as noise.

STCK continuation service per-position medians change by +5.187ms,-9.658ms,-0.898ms,+0.016ms for positions5,6,7,8. The rise is not uniform. Service, request and guard criteria overlap the same actions.
No extra selected Panel proposal is visible on the unaffected controls. Inner unselected observer/admission work is not instrumented in these reports and cannot be assigned a measured cost.
Session medians remain +0.94%STCK and+3.40%SMLP. These totals do not replace the six failed stage-median criteria.
limitations: Only three measured sessions per version; no statistical confidence interval is justified.
Versions were measured in sequential blocks. Static environment equality does not establish identical GC/JIT/scheduling conditions.
Recorded samples are phases, not call counts or allocation profiles; exact work metadata cannot rule out added work inside a phase.
Position, mixture and time-sum diagnostics are explanatory only. The10% threshold and16 original gate metrics remain unchanged.
First comparison and all six unresolved exceedances must remain available even if a later control run differs.

boundedFollowupDeclaredByRoot.qualification: A single predeclared repeat addresses remaining variability; preserve the initial failure and report the follow-up separately. This audit itself authorizes no reclassification.
